baseline_remote_verification: Parent supplied the pushed and read-back commit; this reviewer independently hashed the local committed-receipt copies and compared their contents with the completed APD443 artifact acceptance. No additional remote call was made.

differential_review.normalization: Only standalone build-number tokens 443 to 444 and 442 to 443 were adapted for comparison; embedded numeric digest fragments were left intact.
differential_review.changes_assessed: Predecessor constants now bind completed APD443. Missing-pin checks additionally require original built/source/scan provenance. Coverage floor and predecessor registration advance to 3210/465. Self-test wrapping keeps fixture pins temporary. Operational API/build/history/native/source-scan functions are unchanged.

player_notes.title: Empowered Strike description
player_notes.text: Empowered Strike's ordinary description now states that its readied bonus lasts 10 turns and another staff zap refreshes it. Its damage and wand-effect factors are unchanged.

player_notes.title: Arcane Vision description
player_notes.text: Arcane Vision's ordinary description now includes Transfusion targeting allies and wards hitting surviving targets, and explains that Frost does not trigger it against an already-frozen target. Its effects and duration are unchanged.

reviewed_invariants: Accepted baseline and producing-source ancestry are checked before assembly. Exact completed predecessor receipts, five successful jobs, artifact digests and original compiled history remain required.
An existing frozen APD444 built-pair artifact rejects a new assembly. Workflow concurrency does not cancel an in-progress candidate. No build request exists at review time.

The exact complete core suite, desktop compilation, Android debug/release and instrumentation compilation, and the first JSON ABI check precede assembly. The second JSON ABI check and frozen-pair verification follow it.

Only the build job assembles one Developer APK, one Alpha-Testers APK and the shared instrumentation APK. Native, source-scan and owner stages fetch and verify the frozen artifact; they contain no application assembly.

Original signer, application ID, version code, variant feature bytes, exact predecessor history and actual instrumentation digest remain verified by unchanged shared helpers. No signing configuration is changed.

Source scanning retains full reachable Git history, pinned scanner archive/version and unchanged source-review rules. The report remains bound to the exact produced source ZIP, run and artifact, with reviewed source candidates and disclosed historical findings.
All 25 affected APD443 images remain required, plus four ordinary Empowered Strike and Arcane Vision frames. Six native cases per variant and complete image transfer/hash validation are unchanged.
Owner packaging still requires build, both native variants and exact source-scan success, retains manual and physical-device limits, and does not publish a release.

remaining_gate.explanation: The parent separately confirmed exact source-CI completion and raw XML after the infrastructure review. This receipt does not substitute for the separate full source-CI proof.

limitations: This is a read-only review of finalized infrastructure and exact local evidence, not a fresh application test run, APK assembly, source scan or native execution.
The predecessor acceptance validator uses strict cached Git/API response adapters for its local checks. Real production acceptance still executes the unchanged live checks when the workflow runs.
Ready plan metadata does not mean an APD444 APK has been built, verified or delivered.
